key.voice_chat_transcriber.record: Hold to record, release to transcribe
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.title: Voice Chat Transcriber Settings
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.funasr_pre: Warm up the model after start (no stall on first use)
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.funasr_hin: "Start FunASR service" extracts the bundled scripts, finds Python and installs what is missing (first run downloads ~1.13 GB of models). The service binds to loopback only; closing the game stops the service this session started (one you started by hand is left alone).
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.funasr_end: Service URL corrected to the port the bundled service actually uses: %s
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.funasr_sta: Starting the FunASR service… (the first run also downloads dependencies and models, which takes minutes)
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.funasr_rea: FunASR service is ready; warming the model in the background (~30 s)
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.funasr_sta: Could not start the FunASR service: %s (see config\voice-chat-transcriber\logs)
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.funasr_not: The FunASR service is not running; press K and click "Start FunASR service"
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.model_down: Downloading and verifying the offline model…
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.model_inst: Offline model installed; no API key is needed
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.api_key: API key (blank keeps the saved value)
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.iflytek_cl: iFLYTEK credentials cleared; save to apply
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.offline_hi: Offline mode needs no API key
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.privacy: Offline mode never uploads recordings; online modes send each recording to the selected provider.
message.voice_chat_transcriber.recording: Recording… release the key to transcribe
message.voice_chat_transcriber.transcrib: Transcribing with the local FunASR service…
message.voice_chat_transcriber.funasr_re: The FunASR engine only accepts a loopback address (127.0.0.1 / localhost / ::1)
message.voice_chat_transcriber.funasr_no: The FunASR service is not running; press K and click "Start FunASR service", or run start-funasr.ps1 yourself
message.voice_chat_transcriber.funasr_st: The FunASR service is still loading its models (a first run downloads ~1.13 GB); try again shortly
message.voice_chat_transcriber.need_offl: Press K and download the Chinese offline model first
message.voice_chat_transcriber.ready: Transcription placed in the chat box
message.voice_chat_transcriber.sent: Transcription sent as a chat message
message.voice_chat_transcriber.copied: Transcription copied because another screen is open
message.voice_chat_transcriber.need_key: Configure an API key or use a local endpoint that needs no authentication
message.voice_chat_transcriber.need_ifly: Press K and configure the iFLYTEK AppID, APIKey, and APISecret
screen.voice_chat_transcriber.key_cleare: API key cleared; save to apply
